SELECT (fish_date_doy/10)::int*10 AS doy_bucket,
       SUM(yt) AS yt,
       SUM(anglers) AS ang,
       COUNT(*) AS n,
       ROUND(SUM(yt)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(anglers),0),3) AS rate
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season=2 AND cls IN ('HD_AM','HD_PM','THREE_QUARTER','FULL_DAY')
  AND fish_date_doy BETWEEN 190 AND 280
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT (fished_date_doy/10)::int*10 AS doy_bucket,
       SUM(yt) AS yt,
       SUM(anglers) AS ang,
       COUNT(*) AS n,
       ROUND(SUM(yt)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(anglers),0),3) AS rate
FROM trips
WHERE fished_date_season=2 AND cls IN ('hd_am','hd_pm','hd_unspecified','three_quarter','full_day')
  AND fished_date_doy BETWEEN 190 AND 280
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
